title: Breakdown of Local Denoising as Semantic Speciation
abstract: arXiv:2609.38176v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The dynamics of generative models exhibit two apparently distinct temporal windows: a speciation window, in which a sample commits to a semantic class, and a nonlocality window, in which local context windows become insufficient for generation. Motivated by evidence of their near-concurrence in a variety of frontier models, we investigate their relationship through the spatial distribution of semantic information. Under a "common cause" hypothesis, we prove that the nonlocality window must lie in the speciation window. This hypothesis postulates that semantic labels explain a fraction of the correlations between distant tokens, a condition that is natural for many real datasets. We further give conditions under which both windows shrink to a single limiting time as system size grows, defining a "phase transition", and verify this behavior analytically in Gaussian mixtures. translated_title: 局部去噪的失效即语义物种形成
translated_abstract: 生成模型的动力学表现出两个表面上截然不同的时间窗口：一个是“物种形成窗口”，即样本在这一阶段确定其语义类别；另一个是“非局域性窗口”，即局部上下文窗口不再足以支撑生成。基于这两个窗口在多种前沿模型中几乎同时出现的证据，我们通过语义信息的空间分布来研究二者之间的关系。在“共同原因”假设下，我们证明非局域性窗口必然包含于物种形成窗口之内。该假设假定语义标签能够解释远程词元之间相关性的一部分，这一条件对于许多真实数据集而言是自然成立的。我们进一步给出了当系统规模增大时两个窗口收缩至单一极限时间的条件，从而定义了一种“相变”，并在高斯混合模型中通过解析方法验证了这一行为。综合而言，这些结果识别出了语义……
tldr: 本文在“共同原因”假设下证明生成模型的非局域性窗口必然包含于语义物种形成窗口之内，并指出随着系统规模增大，两个窗口会收缩至同一时刻，呈现出类相变行为。
en_tdlr: Under a "common cause" hypothesis, this paper proves that the nonlocality window of generative models must lie within the semantic speciation window, and shows that both windows collapse to a single limiting time as system size grows, akin to a phase transition.
